Title: System volume low on space
Description: The Windows system volume (C:) has less than 10% free space, which blocks updates, degrades performance and can corrupt user profiles.
Recommendation: Open Storage Guardian, review exact paths and sizes, and confirm a targeted cleanup of temporary files only.
Risks: Cleanup permanently deletes listed files; review the list carefully before approving.
Verification: Free space on C: returns to at least 15%.

Title: Devices with problem codes
Description: One or more devices report a non-zero ConfigManagerErrorCode in Device Manager.
Recommendation: Open Driver Intelligence, locate the failing device, verify the signed local driver package, then roll back or install the matching offline INF.
Risks: Installing an incompatible driver can break the device; NOVA FIX never installs unsigned or mismatched drivers automatically.
Verification: Device Manager shows status OK with no problem code.

Title: Low available memory at scan time
Description: Available RAM is at or below 20% of total during the scan, indicating heavy memory pressure and likely paging.
PossibleCauses: A memory leak in a long-running process
Recommendation: Use Performance Lab to identify top private-memory processes, then disable unnecessary startup entries.
Risks: Disabling a startup entry does not uninstall anything and is reversible.
Verification: After restart and 2 minutes of idle, available RAM is above 20%.

Title: Windows activation status not readable
Description: The activation status could not be read in the current user context (often requires elevation).
Recommendation: Run NOVA FIX as administrator to read activation status, or check Settings > Activation manually.
Verification: Activation status displays a definite value on an elevated run.

Title: Defender real-time protection disabled
Description: Registry evidence shows Windows Defender real-time protection is turned off.
Recommendation: Inspect protection status in One-Click Repair → Defender. If no third-party antivirus is present, re-enable real-time protection in Windows Security.
Risks: Re-enabling protection may conflict with a third-party antivirus — verify before acting.
Verification: Defender status reports real-time protection enabled.

Title: Secure Boot disabled
Description: Secure Boot is reported as disabled on this system.
PossibleCauses: Disabled in firmware for dual-boot or compatibility
Recommendation: If no dual-boot or legacy requirements exist, enable Secure Boot in UEFI firmware settings. NOVA FIX never modifies BIOS settings.
Risks: Changing firmware settings is out of scope for NOVA FIX — do it manually and know your firmware password.
Verification: msinfo32 reports Secure Boot State: On.

Title: One or more diagnostic probes failed
Description: Some probes could not collect data on this system. Each failure is listed with its reason.
PossibleCauses: WMI class not present on this Windows edition
Hardware sensor not exposed by the vendor
Recommendation: Re-run the scan as administrator for full coverage. Failed probes never block the rest of the scan.
Risks: None — this is honest reporting of collection limits.
Verification: Probe failures list is empty after an elevated run.
